§3Optional module. The other half of the fuel cycle: it turns ore into yellowcake.§r
A 5x15x6 process shed running down the platform's FRONT edge, to the left of the silo face.

§5BILL§r
  §9291x§r Clean Stainless Steel Machine Casing
  §913x§r Steel Pipe Casing
  §91x§r Input Bus §8(uraninite)§r, §91x§r Input Hatch §8(Hydrofluoric Acid)§r, §91x§r Output Bus §8(yellowcake)§r
  §8307 blocks. All three sockets sit in the same wall, one course up.§r

§5WHAT IT PRODUCES§r
Every §9600 powered ticks§r (30 seconds):
  §28x Uraninite Dust + 2,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid  ->  2x Yellowcake + 2x Thorium Dust§r
Draws §9480 EU/t§r while it runs - the standalone Yellowcake Mill's rate, unchanged.

§cIT NEEDS POWER TOO, THROUGH THE SAME FOUR SOCKETS§r
§9Powered§r ticks again: the Annex takes its 480 EU/t out of the §9output manifold's ENERGY HATCHES§r - the four §9E§r sockets one course above the dynamos, from step 9 - and not out of the reactor. Fit at least one §9Energy Hatch (IV)§r there and run a live cable into it, or this shed forms perfectly and then never starts a batch.
§8Derrick and Annex together are 2,400 EU/t, which a single IV Energy Hatch carries on its own. Starved, the panel prints §cAnnex: UNDER-POWERED - it draws 480 EU/t and the manifold's Energy Hatches hold§r§8 and then what they actually hold. Nothing is being drawn while it says that - an under-fed module banks the trickle instead of burning it, and simply advances slowly.§r

[note]§6It is a head start, not a shortcut - and that changed in 0.24.0.§r This shed used to pay finished §8Fuel Pellets§r straight out of ore, which skipped all twenty-three steps of §9The Fuel Line§r. It now pays §9YELLOWCAKE§r, at §24 Uraninite per cake§r - the exact ratio F-01 to F-08 reach by hand. So it buys you the eight-step front end and nothing else: §9F-09 onward stays compulsory§r, and it is still the only way to a rod of any grade.[/note]

[warn]§cAnything reading this bus gets a DIFFERENT ITEM than it did in 0.23.0.§r An AE2 storage bus, an interface pattern or a pipe filter pointed at the Annex product bus is now handed §9Yellowcake§r where it used to be handed §9Fuel Pellet (Uranium)§r. Re-filter it before you turn the plant back on.[/warn]

[note]§6Derrick + Annex feed the fuel line; they do not replace it.§r The Derrick digs the uraninite and the Annex converts it, but what comes out is §9feedstock§r - yellowcake and thorium dust. It joins the chain at §9F-09§r, and F-09 to F-18 still have to be standing before any of it becomes a rod. §8No module in this mod makes a finished rod.§r[/note]

[note]These three sockets belong to the Annex alone. The rod cascade can never eat the uraninite you stock here, and nothing the silo demands can reach this acid.[/note]

[warn]The feedstock is committed at the START of a batch. If the product bus cannot take the finished load - full, or item-locked - the batch stalls and says so rather than voiding what it already took.[/warn]

[note]Site: §9a 17-21, c 0-14§r, ground to 5 up.[/note]
